title: Champion/challenger promotion; loops become research, implement, heal
motivation: Moves T14 and T9: every strategy change is backtest-evidenced by construction; the loops' unit of work is an experiment with a verdict
summary: Moves T14 and T9: every strategy change is backtest-evidenced by construction; the loops' unit of work is an experiment with a verdict. Metrics `t14_challengers_evaluated_7d`, `t14_promotions_total`.

title: Count the podcast signal once
motivation: Moves T5 (auditability): one signal, one contribution, visible in the category breakdown
summary: Moves T5 (auditability): one signal, one contribution, visible in the category breakdown. Moves T12 by removing an unevidenced threshold shift; the archived commit cites the before/after crossing count as its backtest evidence for T14.

title: Dashboard home as a decision inbox
motivation: Moves T15 (every held name's verdict and the engine view are one tap away on the phone) and T5 (sizing basis and censoring status are visible where decisions are read)
summary: Moves T15 (every held name's verdict and the engine view are one tap away on the phone) and T5 (sizing basis and censoring status are visible where decisions are read). No new metric.

title: Delete dead scoring code and the orphaned dashboard
motivation: Moves T9: the scoring reviewer and the loops read only live code; `t9_substantive_commit_share_7d` counts a real deletion
summary: Moves T9: the scoring reviewer and the loops read only live code; `t9_substantive_commit_share_7d` counts a real deletion. No metric changes value.

title: Git holds code, config and the journal; data lives in the lake
motivation: Moves T9: loop commits stop carrying data and the reconciler workarounds retire; health metric computation reads columnar tables
summary: Moves T9: loop commits stop carrying data and the reconciler workarounds retire; health metric computation reads columnar tables. T5 unchanged: the audit record is still append-only, now partitioned.

title: Instrument master: one id per security
motivation: Moves T6 (data quality): `ticker_resolution_rate` from 93% toward 100% with 0 unknowns for held names; new `t6_instrument_coverage` (held + universe securities with an instrument id, target 100%)
summary: Moves T6 (data quality): `ticker_resolution_rate` from 93% toward 100% with 0 unknowns for held names; new `t6_instrument_coverage` (held + universe securities with an instrument id, target 100%). Moves T5: audit rows carry `instrument_id`.

title: Data lake bronze: immutable dated raw captures
motivation: Moves T6 and T7 (data quality and freshness): every input is replayable from the day it was captured
summary: Moves T6 and T7 (data quality and freshness): every input is replayable from the day it was captured; new metric `t6_bronze_capture_share_7d` (provider pulls that wrote a bronze record, target 100%).

title: Data lake silver: point-in-time tables and an as-of API
motivation: Moves T6/T7: point-in-time correctness becomes a tested property; T13 and the replay engine depend on it
summary: Moves T6/T7: point-in-time correctness becomes a tested property; T13 and the replay engine depend on it. Metric `t6_silver_coverage` (instruments with prices, fundamentals and owners as-of today, target ≥ 95%).

title: Diagnose the conviction inversion: artefact or crowding
motivation: Moves T12 (decision quality) by settling whether the inversion is measurement or signal, and T14 (learning rate) with a backtest-evidenced adjustment or a backtest-citing no-change justification
summary: Moves T12 (decision quality) by settling whether the inversion is measurement or signal, and T14 (learning rate) with a backtest-evidenced adjustment or a backtest-citing no-change justification. Health: the band-ordering spread is also rep

title: Rebalance category budgets to measured evidence
motivation: Moves T12 (decision quality) with a backtest-evidenced budget change or a backtest-citing no-change, which is what T14 requires
summary: Moves T12 (decision quality) with a backtest-evidenced budget change or a backtest-citing no-change, which is what T14 requires. Health: per-category IC rows already exist; the archived commit cites the validation IC delta.

title: Replay engine: score any policy over any date range
motivation: Moves T14 (learning rate): a verdict on an idea in minutes over years of history; T12 and T13: calibration and benchmark-relative return computed on the same engine that runs live
summary: Moves T14 (learning rate): a verdict on an idea in minutes over years of history; T12 and T13: calibration and benchmark-relative return computed on the same engine that runs live. Metric `t14_replay_runs_7d`.

title: Retail attention and flow feature family
motivation: Moves T12: the family is the first signal group with an eleven-year replay behind it
summary: Moves T12: the family is the first signal group with an eleven-year replay behind it. Metrics `t5_attention_family_coverage_7d`.

title: Weekly memo of at most five actions; daily paper NAV
motivation: Moves T15 and T13: the memo is the recommendation surface the owner reads; NAV versus benchmark is visible daily rather than once per quarter
summary: Moves T15 and T13: the memo is the recommendation surface the owner reads; NAV versus benchmark is visible daily rather than once per quarter. Metric `t15_memo_actions_acted_share_28d`.
